description.value: 49 Below is a small-batch, slow-churned craft ice cream company rooted in Oak Bay, Victoria, making nearly all mix-ins and sauces in-house using a custom dairy base from a local Vancouver Island farm. Founded after a chance encounter with Tuscan gelato, it has grown from a home kitchen subscription business into two neighbourhood scoop shops with seasonal rotating flavours and custom ice cream cakes. The Oak Bay shop on Cadboro Bay Road is a welcoming stop with a community-first ethos and genuine local character.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (2 spaces) at 21m; rack at 30m; rack (6 spaces) at 39m; rack (4 spaces) at 49m. Total: 12 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at https://49below.ca confirms a real, active ice cream business at 2575 Cadboro Bay Road, Oak Bay, matching the OSM address exactly. The website mentions 'Gluten free and vegan options available' for ice cream cakes, and online ordering for pickup is clearly described. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi anywhere on the site; the OSM phone number is not reproduced on the website but is not contradicted either.
concerns: OSM name is '49 Below Craft Ice Cream' but website consistently uses '49 Below Ice Cream' (without 'Craft') in titles and branding.
Website lists a Fernwood location (1288 Gladstone Ave) noted as 'reopening spring 2026' and a Vic West location (420 Craigflower Road) not reflected in OSM — these may warrant separate OSM records.
Phone number not reproduced on website; cannot confirm from website content alone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible ice cream shop in Oak Bay with confirmed address and current website content; a useful stop for touring cyclists.
